theorem four_normalized_edge_face (i : Fin 5) (a : Fin 5 → ℝ)
    (ha : fourWalshParameterFeasible a)
    (hFace : ∀ j, j≠i → 1+2*a j-(∑ k, a k)=0) :
    ∃ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t ∧ t ≤ 1 ∧
      ∀ j, a j=(1-t)/3+t*(if j=i then 1 else 0) := by
  let c : ℝ := ((∑ k, a k)-1)/2
  have hOther (j : Fin 5) (hj : j≠i) : a j=c := by
    have h := hFace j hj
    dsimp [c]
    linarith
  have hForm (j : Fin 5) : a j=if j=i then a i else c := by
    split_ifs with h
    · rw [h]
    · exact hOther j h
  have hSum : (∑ j, a j)=a i+4*c := by
    calc
      _=(∑ j : Fin 5, if j=i then a i else c) := Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => hForm j)
      _=a i+4*c := by fin_cases i <;> norm_num [Fin.sum_univ_succ] <;> ring
  have hAi : a i=1-2*c := by dsimp [c] at hSum ⊢; linarith
  have hUpper : c ≤ 1/3 := by
    have h := ha (fun j => if j=i then 1 else -1)
      (fun j => by split_ifs <;> simp)
      (by fin_cases i <;> norm_num [Fin.prod_univ_succ])
    have hDot : (∑ j : Fin 5, (if j=i then (1:ℝ) else -1)*a j)=a i-4*c := by
      calc
        _=(∑ j : Fin 5, (if j=i then (1:ℝ) else -1)*(if j=i then a i else c)) :=
          Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => by rw [hForm j])
        _=a i-4*c := by fin_cases i <;> norm_num [Fin.sum_univ_succ] <;> ring
    rw [hDot] at h
    linarith
  have hLower : 0 ≤ c := by
    fin_cases i
    · have h := ha (![-1,-1,1,1,1]) (by intro j; fin_cases j <;> norm_num)
        (by norm_num [Fin.prod_univ_succ])
      norm_num [Fin.sum_univ_succ] at h
      change a 0=1-2*c at hAi
      have h1 : a 1=c := hOther 1 (by decide)
      have h2 : a 2=c := hOther 2 (by decide)
      have h3 : a 3=c := hOther 3 (by decide)
      have h4 : a 4=c := hOther 4 (by decide)
      linarith
    · have h := ha (![1,-1,-1,1,1]) (by intro j; fin_cases j <;> norm_num)
        (by norm_num [Fin.prod_univ_succ])
      norm_num [Fin.sum_univ_succ] at h
      change a 1=1-2*c at hAi
      have h0 : a 0=c := hOther 0 (by decide)
      have h2 : a 2=c := hOther 2 (by decide)
      have h3 : a 3=c := hOther 3 (by decide)
      have h4 : a 4=c := hOther 4 (by decide)
      linarith
    · have h := ha (![1,1,-1,-1,1]) (by intro j; fin_cases j <;> norm_num)
        (by norm_num [Fin.prod_univ_succ])
      norm_num [Fin.sum_univ_succ] at h
      change a 2=1-2*c at hAi
      have h0 : a 0=c := hOther 0 (by decide)
      have h1 : a 1=c := hOther 1 (by decide)
      have h3 : a 3=c := hOther 3 (by decide)
      have h4 : a 4=c := hOther 4 (by decide)
      linarith
    · have h := ha (![1,1,1,-1,-1]) (by intro j; fin_cases j <;> norm_num)
        (by norm_num [Fin.prod_univ_succ])
      norm_num [Fin.sum_univ_succ] at h
      change a 3=1-2*c at hAi
      have h0 : a 0=c := hOther 0 (by decide)
      have h1 : a 1=c := hOther 1 (by decide)
      have h2 : a 2=c := hOther 2 (by decide)
      have h4 : a 4=c := hOther 4 (by decide)
      linarith
    · have h := ha (![-1,1,1,1,-1]) (by intro j; fin_cases j <;> norm_num)
        (by norm_num [Fin.prod_univ_succ])
      norm_num [Fin.sum_univ_succ] at h
      change a 4=1-2*c at hAi
      have h0 : a 0=c := hOther 0 (by decide)
      have h1 : a 1=c := hOther 1 (by decide)
      have h2 : a 2=c := hOther 2 (by decide)
      have h3 : a 3=c := hOther 3 (by decide)
      linarith
  refine ⟨1-3*c,by linarith,by linarith,?_⟩
  intro j
  by_cases hj : j=i
  · subst j
    simp only [ite_true]
    linarith
  · rw [hOther j hj,if_neg hj]
    ring


theorem four_parameter_sign_symmetry (a s : Fin 5 → ℝ)
    (ha : fourWalshParameterFeasible a) (hs : ∀ j, s j=1 ∨ s j= -1)
    (hp : (∏ j, s j)=1) : fourWalshParameterFeasible (fun j => s j*a j) := by
  intro v hv hProd
  have hSigns (j : Fin 5) : v j*s j=1 ∨ v j*s j= -1 := by
    rcases hv j with h|h <;> rcases hs j with h'|h' <;> rw [h,h'] <;> norm_num
  have hP : (∏ j, v j*s j)=1 := by rw [Finset.prod_mul_distrib,hp,hProd]; norm_num
  have h := ha (fun j => v j*s j) hSigns hP
  simpa only [mul_assoc] using h

theorem four_walsh_coefficients_segment (p q : (Fin 4 → Bool) → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (j : Fin 5) :
    fourWalshCoefficients (fun x => (1-t)*p x+t*q x) j=
      (1-t)*fourWalshCoefficients p j+t*fourWalshCoefficients q j := by
  unfold fourWalshCoefficients
  simp only [add_mul,Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  rw [Finset.mul_sum,Finset.mul_sum]
  congr 1 <;> apply Finset.sum_congr rfl <;> intro x _ <;> ring

theorem four_walsh_coefficients_injective (p q : (Fin 4 → Bool) → ℝ)
    (hp : cubeProbabilityFeasible p) (hq : cubeProbabilityFeasible q)
    (hCoeff : ∀ j, fourWalshCoefficients p j=fourWalshCoefficients q j) : p=q := by
  funext x
  have h1 := four_walsh_reconstruction p hp x
  have h2 := four_walsh_reconstruction q hq x
  simp only [hCoeff] at h1
  linarith

theorem four_translated_edge_face (s : Fin 4 → Bool) (i : Fin 5) (b : Bool)
    (hb : fourHighCharacter i s=bitSign b) (q : (Fin 4 → Bool) → ℝ)
    (hq : cubeProbabilityFeasible q)
    (hFace : ∀ j, j≠i → 1+2*(fourHighCharacter j s : ℝ)*fourWalshCoefficients q j-
      (∑ k, (fourHighCharacter k s : ℝ)*fourWalshCoefficients q k)=0) :
    ∃ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t ∧ t ≤ 1 ∧
      q=fun x => (1-t)*fourTranslatedLaw s x+t*fourUniformLaw i b x := by
  have hs (j : Fin 5) : (fourHighCharacter j s : ℝ)=1 ∨ (fourHighCharacter j s : ℝ)= -1 := by
    rcases (four_translated_certificate s).2.2.2.2.2 j with h|h
    · left; exact_mod_cast h
    · right; exact_mod_cast h
  have hProd : (∏ j : Fin 5, (fourHighCharacter j s : ℝ))=1 := by
    exact_mod_cast four_high_character_certificate.2.2.2.2.1 s
  have hP := four_parameter_sign_symmetry (fourWalshCoefficients q)
    (fun j => (fourHighCharacter j s : ℝ)) (four_coefficients_feasible q hq) hs hProd
  have hFace' : ∀ j, j≠i → 1+2*((fourHighCharacter j s : ℝ)*fourWalshCoefficients q j)-
      (∑ k, (fourHighCharacter k s : ℝ)*fourWalshCoefficients q k)=0 := by
    intro j hj; simpa only [mul_assoc] using hFace j hj
  obtain ⟨t,ht0,ht1,hCoeff⟩ := four_normalized_edge_face i _ hP hFace'
  refine ⟨t,ht0,ht1,?_⟩
  apply four_walsh_coefficients_injective q _ hq
    (cube_probability_feasible_segment (four_translated_feasible s) (four_uniform_feasible i b) ht0 ht1)
  intro j
  rw [four_walsh_coefficients_segment,four_translated_coefficients,four_uniform_coefficients]
  have h := hCoeff j
  have hbi : (bitSign b : ℝ)=(fourHighCharacter i s : ℝ) := by rw [hb]
  rw [hbi]
  by_cases hj : j=i
  · subst j
    simp only [ite_true] at h ⊢
    rcases hs i with hS|hS <;> rw [hS] at h ⊢ <;> linarith
  · simp only [if_neg hj] at h ⊢
    rcases hs j with hS|hS <;> rw [hS] at h ⊢ <;> linarith

theorem nonnegative_slack_face_exposed {E ι : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [NormedSpace ℝ E] [Fintype ι] (P : Set E) (L : ι → StrongDual ℝ E) (c : ι → ℝ)
    (hPos : ∀ x ∈ P, ∀ j, 0 ≤ c j+L j x) :
    IsExposed ℝ P {x ∈ P | ∀ j, c j+L j x=0} := by
  classical
  intro hNonempty
  obtain ⟨x0,hx0,hZero⟩ := hNonempty
  let l : StrongDual ℝ E := -(∑ j, L j)
  have hEval (x : E) : l x= -(∑ j, L j x) := by simp [l]
  have hSum0 : (∑ j, c j)+(∑ j, L j x0)=0 := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    simp only [hZero,Finset.sum_const_zero]
  refine ⟨l,?_⟩
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hx,hz⟩
    refine ⟨hx,?_⟩
    intro y hy
    have hSum : (∑ j, c j)+(∑ j, L j x)=0 := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]; simp only [hz,Finset.sum_const_zero]
    have hY : 0 ≤ (∑ j, c j)+(∑ j, L j y) := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => hPos y hy j)
    rw [hEval,hEval]
    linarith
  · rintro ⟨hx,hMax⟩
    refine ⟨hx,?_⟩
    have hLe := hMax x0 hx0
    rw [hEval,hEval] at hLe
    have hSum : (∑ j, (c j+L j x))=0 := by
      have hNonneg := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j (_ : j∈Finset.univ) => hPos x hx j)
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib] at hNonneg ⊢
      linarith
    exact (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun j _ => hPos x hx j)).mp hSum |> fun h j => h j (Finset.mem_univ j)

noncomputable def fourWalshCoefficientLinear (j : Fin 5) :
    StrongDual ℝ ((Fin 4 → Bool) → ℝ) :=
  ∑ x : Fin 4 → Bool, (fourHighCharacter j x : ℝ) • ContinuousLinearMap.proj x

theorem four_walsh_coefficient_linear_apply (j : Fin 5) (q : (Fin 4 → Bool) → ℝ) :
    fourWalshCoefficientLinear j q=fourWalshCoefficients q j := by
  simp [fourWalshCoefficientLinear,fourWalshCoefficients,mul_comm]

theorem four_parameter_slack_nonnegative (s : Fin 5 → ℝ)
    (hs : ∀ j, s j=1 ∨ s j= -1) (hProd : (∏ j, s j)=1)
    (a : Fin 5 → ℝ) (ha : fourWalshParameterFeasible a) (j : Fin 5) :
    0 ≤ 1+2*s j*a j-(∑ k, s k*a k) := by
  let v : Fin 5 → ℝ := fun k => (if k=j then 1 else -1)*s k
  have hV (k : Fin 5) : v k=1 ∨ v k= -1 := by
    dsimp [v]
    split_ifs <;> rcases hs k with h|h <;> rw [h] <;> norm_num
  have hP : (∏ k, v k)=1 := by
    dsimp [v]
    rw [Finset.prod_mul_distrib,hProd,mul_one]
    fin_cases j <;> norm_num [Fin.prod_univ_succ]
  have h := ha v hV hP
  have hDot : (∑ k, v k*a k)=2*s j*a j-(∑ k, s k*a k) := by
    calc
      _=∑ k : Fin 5, ((if k=j then 2*s j*a j else 0)-s k*a k) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro k _
        dsimp [v]
        split_ifs with hk
        · subst k; ring
        · ring
      _=_ := by simp [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  rw [hDot] at h
  linarith

theorem four_segment_common_slacks (s : Fin 4 → Bool) (i : Fin 5) (b : Bool)
    (hb : fourHighCharacter i s=bitSign b) (t : ℝ) :
    ∀ j, j≠i →
      1+2*(fourHighCharacter j s : ℝ)*
        fourWalshCoefficients (fun x => (1-t)*fourTranslatedLaw s x+t*fourUniformLaw i b x) j-
      (∑ k, (fourHighCharacter k s : ℝ)*
        fourWalshCoefficients (fun x => (1-t)*fourTranslatedLaw s x+t*fourUniformLaw i b x) k)=0 := by
  let q : (Fin 4 → Bool) → ℝ := fun x => (1-t)*fourTranslatedLaw s x+t*fourUniformLaw i b x
  have hN (j : Fin 5) : (fourHighCharacter j s : ℝ)*fourWalshCoefficients q j=
      (1-t)/3+t*(if j=i then 1 else 0) := by
    dsimp [q]
    rw [four_walsh_coefficients_segment,four_translated_coefficients,four_uniform_coefficients]
    have hS : (fourHighCharacter j s : ℝ)=1 ∨ (fourHighCharacter j s : ℝ)= -1 := by
      rcases (four_translated_certificate s).2.2.2.2.2 j with h|h
      · left; exact_mod_cast h
      · right; exact_mod_cast h
    by_cases hj : j=i
    · subst j
      rw [← hb]
      simp only [ite_true]
      rcases hS with h|h <;> rw [h] <;> ring
    · simp only [if_neg hj]
      rcases hS with h|h <;> rw [h] <;> ring
  have hSum : (∑ k, (fourHighCharacter k s : ℝ)*fourWalshCoefficients q k)=5*((1-t)/3)+t := by
    simp only [hN]
    fin_cases i <;> norm_num [Fin.sum_univ_succ] <;> ring
  intro j hj
  change 1+2*(fourHighCharacter j s : ℝ)*fourWalshCoefficients q j-
    (∑ k, (fourHighCharacter k s : ℝ)*fourWalshCoefficients q k)=0
  rw [mul_assoc,hN,hSum,if_neg hj]
  ring

theorem four_bit_escape_exposed_edge (s : Fin 4 → Bool) (i : Fin 5) (b : Bool)
    (hb : fourHighCharacter i s=bitSign b) :
    IsExposed ℝ {q : (Fin 4 → Bool) → ℝ | cubeProbabilityFeasible q}
      (segment ℝ (fourTranslatedLaw s) (fourUniformLaw i b)) ∧
    fourTranslatedLaw s≠fourUniformLaw i b := by
  classical
  let J := {j : Fin 5 // j≠i}
  let L : J → StrongDual ℝ ((Fin 4 → Bool) → ℝ) := fun j =>
    (2*(fourHighCharacter j.val s : ℝ)) • fourWalshCoefficientLinear j.val -
      ∑ k : Fin 5, (fourHighCharacter k s : ℝ) • fourWalshCoefficientLinear k
  have hEval (j : J) (q : (Fin 4 → Bool) → ℝ) : L j q=
      2*(fourHighCharacter j.val s : ℝ)*fourWalshCoefficients q j.val-
        (∑ k, (fourHighCharacter k s : ℝ)*fourWalshCoefficients q k) := by
    simp [L,four_walsh_coefficient_linear_apply]
  have hs (j : Fin 5) : (fourHighCharacter j s : ℝ)=1 ∨ (fourHighCharacter j s : ℝ)= -1 := by
    rcases (four_translated_certificate s).2.2.2.2.2 j with h|h
    · left; exact_mod_cast h
    · right; exact_mod_cast h
  have hProd : (∏ j : Fin 5, (fourHighCharacter j s : ℝ))=1 := by
    exact_mod_cast four_high_character_certificate.2.2.2.2.1 s
  have hPos (q : (Fin 4 → Bool) → ℝ) (hq : cubeProbabilityFeasible q) (j : J) :
      0 ≤ (1:ℝ)+L j q := by
    rw [hEval]
    have h := four_parameter_slack_nonnegative (fun k => (fourHighCharacter k s : ℝ)) hs hProd
      (fourWalshCoefficients q) (four_coefficients_feasible q hq) j.val
    linarith
  have hEx := nonnegative_slack_face_exposed {q : (Fin 4 → Bool) → ℝ | cubeProbabilityFeasible q}
    L (fun _ => 1) hPos
  have hSet : {q : (Fin 4 → Bool) → ℝ | cubeProbabilityFeasible q ∧ ∀ j : J, 1+L j q=0}=
      segment ℝ (fourTranslatedLaw s) (fourUniformLaw i b) := by
    ext q
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hq,hFace⟩
      have hF (j : Fin 5) (hj : j≠i) :
          1+2*(fourHighCharacter j s : ℝ)*fourWalshCoefficients q j-
            (∑ k, (fourHighCharacter k s : ℝ)*fourWalshCoefficients q k)=0 := by
        have h := hFace ⟨j,hj⟩
        rw [hEval] at h
        linarith
      obtain ⟨t,ht0,ht1,hqEq⟩ := four_translated_edge_face s i b hb q hq hF
      rw [segment_eq_image]
      refine ⟨t,⟨ht0,ht1⟩,?_⟩
      ext x
      exact (congrFun hqEq x).symm
    · rw [segment_eq_image]
      rintro ⟨t,ht,rfl⟩
      refine ⟨cube_probability_feasible_segment (four_translated_feasible s)
        (four_uniform_feasible i b) ht.1 ht.2,?_⟩
      intro j
      rw [hEval]
      have h := four_segment_common_slacks s i b hb t j.val j.property
      change 1+(2*(fourHighCharacter j.val s : ℝ)*
        fourWalshCoefficients (fun x => (1-t)*fourTranslatedLaw s x+t*fourUniformLaw i b x) j.val-
        (∑ k, (fourHighCharacter k s : ℝ)*
          fourWalshCoefficients (fun x => (1-t)*fourTranslatedLaw s x+t*fourUniformLaw i b x) k))=0
      linarith
  refine ⟨?_,?_⟩
  · rw [← hSet]
    exact hEx
  · intro hEq
    have hC := congrArg collision hEq
    rw [four_translated_collision,four_uniform_collision] at hC
    norm_num at hC


theorem exposed_segment_supported_kernel {ι α : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype α]
    [DecidableEq α] (A : Matrix ι α ℝ) (b : ι → ℝ) (p q : α → ℝ)
    (hp : feasibleLaw A b p) (hq : feasibleLaw A b q)
    (hEdge : IsExposed ℝ {v | feasibleLaw A b v} (segment ℝ p q))
    (c : ℝ) (hc : 0<c)
    (hLower : ∀ x, (p x+q x)/2=0 ∨ c ≤ (p x+q x)/2)
    (z : α → ℝ) (hAz : A.mulVec z=0) (hSum : ∑ x, z x=0)
    (hSupport : ∀ x, p x=0 → q x=0 → z x=0) :
    ∃ r : ℝ, z=r • (q-p) := by
  classical
  let m : α → ℝ := fun x => (p x+q x)/2
  have hm : feasibleLaw A b m := by
    refine ⟨fun x => div_nonneg (add_nonneg (hp.1 x) (hq.1 x)) (by norm_num),?_,?_⟩
    · change (∑ x, (p x+q x)/2)=1
      rw [← Finset.sum_div,Finset.sum_add_distrib,hp.2.1,hq.2.1]
      norm_num
    · have hFn : m=(1/2:ℝ) • p+(1/2:ℝ) • q := by ext x; simp [m]; ring
      rw [hFn,Matrix.mulVec_add,Matrix.mulVec_smul,Matrix.mulVec_smul,hp.2.2,hq.2.2]
      ext j
      simp only [Pi.add_apply,Pi.smul_apply,smul_eq_mul]
      ring
  let t : ℝ := c/(2*(1+‖z‖))
  have hDen : 0<2*(1+‖z‖) := by positivity
  have ht : 0<t := div_pos hc hDen
  have htEq : t*(2*(1+‖z‖))=c := div_mul_cancel₀ c (ne_of_gt hDen)
  have htN : t*‖z‖ ≤ c := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg z]
  have hCoord (x : α) : |z x| ≤ ‖z‖ := by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using norm_le_pi_norm z x
  have hNonneg (s : ℝ) (hs : s=t ∨ s= -t) (x : α) : 0 ≤ m x+s*z x := by
    rcases hLower x with h0|hL
    · have hP0 : p x=0 := by have hP:=hp.1 x; have hQ:=hq.1 x; linarith
      have hQ0 : q x=0 := by have hP:=hp.1 x; have hQ:=hq.1 x; linarith
      have hZ := hSupport x hP0 hQ0
      simp [m,hP0,hQ0,hZ]
    · have hZi := abs_le.mp (hCoord x)
      have hLo := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hZi.1 ht.le
      have hHi := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hZi.2 ht.le
      change c ≤ m x at hL
      rcases hs with rfl|rfl <;> nlinarith
  have hFeasible (s : ℝ) (hs : s=t ∨ s= -t) :
      feasibleLaw A b (fun x => m x+s*z x) := by
    refine ⟨hNonneg s hs,?_,?_⟩
    · simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib,← Finset.mul_sum,hSum,mul_zero,add_zero,hm.2.1]
    · change A.mulVec (m+s • z)=b
      rw [Matrix.mulVec_add,Matrix.mulVec_smul,hm.2.2,hAz,smul_zero,add_zero]
  let v : α → ℝ := fun x => m x+t*z x
  let w : α → ℝ := fun x => m x-t*z x
  have hv : feasibleLaw A b v := hFeasible t (Or.inl rfl)
  have hw : feasibleLaw A b w := by
    simpa only [w,neg_mul,sub_eq_add_neg] using hFeasible (-t) (Or.inr rfl)
  have hMedge : m∈segment ℝ p q := by
    refine ⟨1/2,1/2,by norm_num,by norm_num,by norm_num,?_⟩
    ext x
    simp only [Pi.add_apply,Pi.smul_apply,smul_eq_mul,m]
    ring
  have hMopen : m∈openSegment ℝ v w := by
    refine ⟨1/2,1/2,by norm_num,by norm_num,by norm_num,?_⟩
    ext x
    change (1/2:ℝ)*(m x+t*z x)+(1/2:ℝ)*(m x-t*z x)=m x
    ring

def fourAxisVertex (i : Fin 5) (s : ℝ) : Fin 5 → ℝ := fun j => if j=i then s else 0

theorem convex_weighted_sum_le_one {E ι : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E]
    [Fintype ι] (S : Set E) (hS : Convex ℝ S) (hZero : (0:E)∈S)
    (w : ι → ℝ) (z : ι → E) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hMass : (∑ i, w i) ≤ 1)
    (hz : ∀ i, z i∈S) : (∑ i, w i • z i)∈S := by
  classical
  let W : Option ι → ℝ := fun i => i.elim (1-∑ j,w j) w
  let Z : Option ι → E := fun i => i.elim 0 z
  have hW (i : Option ι) : 0 ≤ W i := by
    cases i with
    | none => exact sub_nonneg.mpr hMass
    | some i => exact hw i
  have hSum : (∑ i : Option ι, W i)=1 := by simp [W,Fintype.sum_option]
  have hZ (i : Option ι) : Z i∈S := by
    cases i with
    | none => exact hZero
    | some i => exact hz i
  have h := hS.sum_mem (fun i (_ : i∈Finset.univ) => hW i) hSum
    (fun i (_ : i∈Finset.univ) => hZ i)
  simpa [W,Z,Fintype.sum_option] using h

theorem four_vertex_zero_in_hull : (0 : Fin 5 → ℝ)∈convexHull ℝ fourParameterVertexSet := by
  have hp : fourAxisVertex 0 1∈fourParameterVertexSet := Or.inl ⟨0,false,by simp [bitSign]⟩
  have hm : fourAxisVertex 0 (-1)∈fourParameterVertexSet := Or.inl ⟨0,true,by simp [bitSign]⟩
  have h := (convex_convexHull ℝ fourParameterVertexSet)
    (subset_convexHull ℝ fourParameterVertexSet hp) (subset_convexHull ℝ fourParameterVertexSet hm)
    (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)≤1/2) (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)≤1/2) (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ)+1/2=1)
  have hEq : (1/2:ℝ) • fourAxisVertex 0 1+(1/2:ℝ) • fourAxisVertex 0 (-1)=0 := by
    ext j
    simp only [Pi.add_apply,Pi.smul_apply,smul_eq_mul,fourAxisVertex,Pi.zero_apply]
    split_ifs <;> ring
  rwa [hEq] at h

theorem four_signed_absolute_coordinates (a : Fin 5 → ℝ) :
    ∃ s : Fin 5 → ℝ, (∀ i, s i=1 ∨ s i= -1) ∧
      (∀ i, s i*a i=|a i|) ∧ (∀ i, s i*|a i|=a i) ∧
      ((∏ i, s i)=1 ∨ (∏ i, s i)= -1) := by
  let s : Fin 5 → ℝ := fun i => if 0 ≤ a i then 1 else -1
  have hs (i : Fin 5) : s i=1 ∨ s i= -1 := by dsimp [s]; split_ifs <;> simp
  refine ⟨s,hs,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · intro i
    dsimp [s]
    split_ifs with h
    · simp [abs_of_nonneg h]
    · simp [abs_of_neg (lt_of_not_ge h)]
  · intro i
    dsimp [s]
    split_ifs with h
    · simp [abs_of_nonneg h]
    · simp [abs_of_neg (lt_of_not_ge h)]
  · rcases hs 0 with h0|h0 <;> rcases hs 1 with h1|h1 <;>
      rcases hs 2 with h2|h2 <;> rcases hs 3 with h3|h3 <;>
      rcases hs 4 with h4|h4 <;> norm_num [Fin.prod_univ_succ,h0,h1,h2,h3,h4]

theorem four_axis_vertex_in_hull (i : Fin 5) (s : ℝ) (hs : s=1 ∨ s= -1) :

theorem four_signed_axis_decomposition (a s : Fin 5 → ℝ)
    (hs : ∀ i, s i=1 ∨ s i= -1) (hCoord : ∀ i, s i*|a i|=a i)
    (hMass : (∑ i, |a i|) ≤ 1) : a∈convexHull ℝ fourParameterVertexSet := by
  have h := convex_weighted_sum_le_one (convexHull ℝ fourParameterVertexSet)
    (convex_convexHull ℝ fourParameterVertexSet) four_vertex_zero_in_hull
    (fun i => |a i|) (fun i => fourAxisVertex i (s i))
    (fun i => abs_nonneg _) hMass (fun i => four_axis_vertex_in_hull i (s i) (hs i))
  have hEq : (∑ i, |a i| • fourAxisVertex i (s i))=a := by
    ext j
    simp only [Finset.sum_apply,Pi.smul_apply,smul_eq_mul,fourAxisVertex,mul_ite,mul_zero]
    simp only [Finset.sum_ite_eq,Finset.mem_univ,ite_true]
    rw [mul_comm,hCoord]
  rwa [hEq] at h

theorem four_weighted_vertex_decomposition (a s : Fin 5 → ℝ)
    (hs : ∀ i, s i=1 ∨ s i= -1) (hProd : (∏ i, s i)=1)
    (hCoord : ∀ i, s i*|a i|=a i) (m : ℝ) (hm : 0 ≤ m)
    (hMin : ∀ i, m ≤ |a i|) (hMass : (∑ i, |a i|)-2*m ≤ 1) :
    a∈convexHull ℝ fourParameterVertexSet := by
  let w : Fin 6 → ℝ := Fin.cons (3*m) (fun i : Fin 5 => |a i|-m)
  let z : Fin 6 → (Fin 5 → ℝ) := Fin.cons (fun i : Fin 5 => s i/3)
    (fun i : Fin 5 => fourAxisVertex i (s i))
  have hW (i : Fin 6) : 0 ≤ w i := by
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
    · change 0 ≤ 3*m; positivity
    · exact sub_nonneg.mpr (hMin j)
  have hSum : (∑ i, w i) ≤ 1 := by
    dsimp [w]
    norm_num [Fin.sum_univ_succ] at hMass ⊢
    linarith
  have hZ (i : Fin 6) : z i∈convexHull ℝ fourParameterVertexSet := by
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
    · apply subset_convexHull ℝ fourParameterVertexSet
      right; exact ⟨s,hs,hProd,rfl⟩
    · exact four_axis_vertex_in_hull j (s j) (hs j)
  have h := convex_weighted_sum_le_one (convexHull ℝ fourParameterVertexSet)
    (convex_convexHull ℝ fourParameterVertexSet) four_vertex_zero_in_hull w z hW hSum hZ
  have hEq : (∑ i, w i • z i)=a := by
    ext j
    rw [← hCoord j]
    fin_cases j <;> norm_num [w,z,Fin.sum_univ_succ,fourAxisVertex] <;> ring
  rwa [hEq] at h

theorem four_parameter_mem_vertex_hull (a : Fin 5 → ℝ) (ha : fourWalshParameterFeasible a) :
    a∈convexHull ℝ fourParameterVertexSet := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨s,hs,hAbs,hCoord,hProd⟩ := four_signed_absolute_coordinates a
  rcases hProd with hProd|hProd
  · obtain ⟨j,hj,hMin⟩ := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 5)).exists_min_image (fun i => |a i|) Finset.univ_nonempty
    have hBound := four_parameter_slack_nonnegative s hs hProd a ha j
    have hB : 0 ≤ 1+2*(s j*a j)-(∑ k, s k*a k) := by linarith
    simp only [hAbs] at hB
    exact four_weighted_vertex_decomposition a s hs hProd hCoord |a j| (abs_nonneg _)
      (fun i => hMin i (Finset.mem_univ i)) (by linarith)
  · have hSigns (j : Fin 5) : -s j=1 ∨ -s j= -1 := by
      rcases hs j with h|h <;> rw [h] <;> norm_num
    have hP : (∏ j, -s j)=1 := by norm_num [Finset.prod_neg,hProd]
    have h := ha (fun j => -s j) hSigns hP
    have hDot : (∑ j, -s j*a j)= -(∑ j, |a j|) := by
      simp only [neg_mul,hAbs,Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
    rw [hDot] at h
    exact four_signed_axis_decomposition a s hs hCoord (by linarith)

theorem five_sign_product_one_sum_lower (s : Fin 5 → ℝ)

theorem four_parameter_vertex_feasible (a : Fin 5 → ℝ) (ha : a∈fourParameterVertexSet) :

theorem four_parameter_law_coefficients (a : Fin 5 → ℝ) (j : Fin 5) :
    fourWalshCoefficients (fourParameterLaw a) j=a j := by
  have hMean : (∑ x, (fourHighCharacter j x : ℝ))=0 := by
    exact_mod_cast four_high_character_certificate.1 j
  have hGram (i : Fin 5) :
      (∑ x, (fourHighCharacter i x : ℝ)*(fourHighCharacter j x : ℝ))=
        if i=j then (16:ℝ) else 0 := by
    have h := congrArg (fun n : ℤ => (n:ℝ)) (four_high_character_certificate.2.2.2.1 i j)
    push_cast at h
    by_cases hij : i=j <;> simp [hij] at h ⊢ <;> exact h
  have hPoint (x : Fin 4 → Bool) : fourParameterLaw a x*(fourHighCharacter j x : ℝ)=
      ((fourHighCharacter j x : ℝ)+∑ i, a i*((fourHighCharacter i x : ℝ)*(fourHighCharacter j x : ℝ)))/16 := by
    unfold fourParameterLaw
    have hS : (∑ i, a i*(fourHighCharacter i x : ℝ))*(fourHighCharacter j x : ℝ)=
        ∑ i, a i*((fourHighCharacter i x : ℝ)*(fourHighCharacter j x : ℝ)) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_mul]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro i _; ring
    rw [← hS]
    ring
  unfold fourWalshCoefficients
  simp_rw [hPoint]
  rw [← Finset.sum_div,Finset.sum_add_distrib,hMean,zero_add,Finset.sum_comm]
  have hS (i : Fin 5) : (∑ x, a i*((fourHighCharacter i x : ℝ)*(fourHighCharacter j x : ℝ)))=
      a i*(if i=j then (16:ℝ) else 0) := by rw [← Finset.mul_sum,hGram]
  simp only [hS,mul_ite,mul_zero,Finset.sum_ite_eq',Finset.mem_univ,ite_true]

theorem four_parameter_law_affine (a b : Fin 5 → ℝ) (u v : ℝ) (huv : u+v=1) :

theorem four_real_parity_signs_code (s : Fin 5 → ℝ)
    (hs : ∀ j, s j=1 ∨ s j= -1) (hp : (∏ j, s j)=1) :
    ∃ u : Fin 4 → Bool, ∀ j, (fourHighCharacter j u : ℝ)=s j := by
  classical
  let vb : Fin 5 → Bool := fun j => if s j=1 then false else true
  have hV (j : Fin 5) : (bitSign (vb j) : ℝ)=s j := by
    rcases hs j with h|h <;> norm_num [vb,h,bitSign]
  have hProd : (∏ j, bitSign (vb j))=(1:ℤ) := by
    have hReal : (∏ j, (bitSign (vb j) : ℝ))=1 := by simpa only [hV] using hp
    exact_mod_cast hReal
  obtain ⟨u,hu⟩ := four_high_character_certificate.2.2.2.2.2 vb hProd

  intro j

theorem four_axis_vertex_law (i : Fin 5) (b : Bool) :

theorem four_parameter_law_feasible (a : Fin 5 → ℝ) (ha : fourWalshParameterFeasible a) :

    · obtain ⟨u,hu⟩ := four_weighted_vertex_law s hs hProd
      rw [hu]; exact four_translated_feasible u

theorem strict_convex_finite_coordinate_sum {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : StrictConvexOn ℝ (Ici 0) f) :
    StrictConvexOn ℝ {p : α → ℝ | ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i} (fun p => ∑ i, f (p i)) := by
  classical
  refine ⟨?_,?_⟩
  · intro p hp q hq a b ha hb _ i
    exact add_nonneg (mul_nonneg ha (hp i)) (mul_nonneg hb (hq i))
  · intro p hp q hq hpq a b ha hb hab
    have hNe : ∃ i, p i≠q i := by
      by_contra h
      push Not at h
      exact hpq (funext h)
    obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := hNe
    have hLe (j : α) : f (a*p j+b*q j) ≤ a*f (p j)+b*f (q j) :=
      hf.convexOn.2 (hp j) (hq j) ha.le hb.le hab
    have hLt : f (a*p i+b*q i) < a*f (p i)+b*f (q i) :=
      hf.2 (hp i) (hq i) hi ha hb hab
    change (∑ j, f (a*p j+b*q j)) < a*(∑ j, f (p j))+b*(∑ j, f (q j))
    rw [Finset.mul_sum,Finset.mul_sum,← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    exact Finset.sum_lt_sum (fun j _ => hLe j) ⟨i,Finset.mem_univ i,hLt⟩

theorem strict_convex_global_max_extreme {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E]
    (P : Set E) (f : E → ℝ) (hf : StrictConvexOn ℝ P f)
    (x : E) (hx : x∈P) (hMax : ∀ y∈P, f y ≤ f x) : x∈P.extremePoints ℝ := by
  refine ⟨hx,?_⟩
  intro y hy z hz hSeg
  by_cases hyz : y=z
  · subst z
    rw [openSegment_same] at hSeg
    exact hSeg.symm
  · have hLt := hf.lt_on_openSegment hy hz hyz hSeg
    have hLe : max (f y) (f z) ≤ f x := max_le (hMax y hy) (hMax z hz)
    exact False.elim (not_lt_of_ge hLe hLt)

theorem finite_power_sum_strict_convex {α : Type*} [Fintype α] {r : ℝ} (hr : 1<r) :
    StrictConvexOn ℝ {p : α → ℝ | ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i} (fun p => ∑ i, (p i)^r) :=
  strict_convex_finite_coordinate_sum _ (strictConvexOn_rpow hr)

theorem finite_negative_power_sum_strict_convex {α : Type*} [Fintype α] {r : ℝ}
    (hr0 : 0<r) (hr1 : r<1) :
    StrictConvexOn ℝ {p : α → ℝ | ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i} (fun p => -(∑ i, (p i)^r)) := by
  have h := strict_convex_finite_coordinate_sum (fun x : ℝ => -x^r)
    (Real.strictConcaveOn_rpow hr0 hr1).neg (α := α)
  simpa only [Finset.sum_neg_distrib] using h

theorem finite_negative_shannon_strict_convex {α : Type*} [Fintype α] :
    StrictConvexOn ℝ {p : α → ℝ | ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i}
      (fun p => ∑ i, p i*Real.log (p i)) :=
  strict_convex_finite_coordinate_sum _ Real.strictConvexOn_mul_log

theorem strict_convex_affine_pullback {E F : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E]
    [AddCommGroup F] [Module ℝ F] (S : Set E) (Q : Set F) (T : E → F) (f : F → ℝ)
    (hS : Convex ℝ S) (hf : StrictConvexOn ℝ Q f)
    (hMap : ∀ x∈S, T x∈Q) (hInjective : Function.Injective T)
    (hAffine : ∀ (x y : E) (a b : ℝ), a+b=1 → T (a • x+b • y)=a • T x+b • T y) :
    StrictConvexOn ℝ S (fun x => f (T x)) := by
  refine ⟨hS,?_⟩
  intro x hx y hy hxy a b ha hb hab
  change f (T (a • x+b • y)) < a*f (T x)+b*f (T y)
  rw [hAffine x y a b hab]
  exact hf.2 (hMap x hx) (hMap y hy) (fun h => hxy (hInjective h)) ha hb hab

theorem strict_convex_hull_maximizer_in_generators {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E]
    (S : Set E) (f : E → ℝ) (hf : StrictConvexOn ℝ (convexHull ℝ S) f)
    (x : E) (hx : x∈convexHull ℝ S) (hMax : ∀ y∈convexHull ℝ S, f y ≤ f x) : x∈S := by
  exact extremePoints_convexHull_subset
    (strict_convex_global_max_extreme (convexHull ℝ S) f hf x hx hMax)

theorem four_objective_strict_convex (f : ((Fin 4 → Bool) → ℝ) → ℝ)

    StrictConvexOn ℝ {a : Fin 5 → ℝ | fourWalshParameterFeasible a}
      (fun a => f (fourParameterLaw a)) := by
  apply strict_convex_affine_pullback _ _ fourParameterLaw f four_parameter_feasible_convex hf
  · intro a ha
    exact (four_parameter_law_feasible a ha).1
  · exact four_parameter_law_injective
  · exact four_parameter_law_affine

theorem four_objective_upper_bound (f : ((Fin 4 → Bool) → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hf : StrictConvexOn ℝ {p : (Fin 4 → Bool) → ℝ | ∀ x, 0 ≤ p x} f)
    (U W : ℝ) (hU : ∀ i b, f (fourUniformLaw i b)=U)
    (hW : ∀ s, f (fourTranslatedLaw s)=W)
    (q : (Fin 4 → Bool) → ℝ) (hq : cubeProbabilityFeasible q) : f q ≤ max U W := by
  have hStrict := four_objective_strict_convex f hf
  have hConvex := hStrict.convexOn.convex_le (max U W)
  have hVertex : fourParameterVertexSet ⊆
      {a : Fin 5 → ℝ | fourWalshParameterFeasible a ∧ f (fourParameterLaw a) ≤ max U W} := by
    intro a ha
    refine ⟨four_parameter_vertex_feasible a ha,?_⟩
    rcases ha with ⟨i,b,rfl⟩|⟨s,hs,hProd,rfl⟩
    · rw [four_axis_vertex_law,hU]; exact le_max_left U W
    · obtain ⟨u,hu⟩ := four_weighted_vertex_law s hs hProd
      rw [hu,hW]; exact le_max_right U W
  have hHull := convexHull_min hVertex hConvex
  have hIn := hHull (four_parameter_mem_vertex_hull (fourWalshCoefficients q) (four_coefficients_feasible q hq))
  change fourWalshParameterFeasible (fourWalshCoefficients q) ∧ f (fourParameterLaw (fourWalshCoefficients q)) ≤ max U W at hIn
  rw [four_parameter_law_reconstruct q hq] at hIn
  exact hIn.2

theorem four_objective_global_maximizers (f : ((Fin 4 → Bool) → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hf : StrictConvexOn ℝ {p : (Fin 4 → Bool) → ℝ | ∀ x, 0 ≤ p x} f)
    (U W : ℝ) (hU : ∀ i b, f (fourUniformLaw i b)=U)
    (hW : ∀ s, f (fourTranslatedLaw s)=W)
    (q : (Fin 4 → Bool) → ℝ) (hq : cubeProbabilityFeasible q) :
    (∀ v : (Fin 4 → Bool) → ℝ, cubeProbabilityFeasible v → f v ≤ f q) ↔
      (∃ (i : Fin 5) (b : Bool), q=fourUniformLaw i b ∧ W ≤ U) ∨
      (∃ s : Fin 4 → Bool, q=fourTranslatedLaw s ∧ U ≤ W) := by
  constructor
  · intro hMax
    let a := fourWalshCoefficients q
    have ha : a∈convexHull ℝ fourParameterVertexSet :=
      four_parameter_mem_vertex_hull a (four_coefficients_feasible q hq)
    have hStrict : StrictConvexOn ℝ (convexHull ℝ fourParameterVertexSet)
        (fun a => f (fourParameterLaw a)) := by
      rw [four_parameter_polytope_hull]
      exact four_objective_strict_convex f hf
    have hMaxA (v : Fin 5 → ℝ) (hv : v∈convexHull ℝ fourParameterVertexSet) :
        f (fourParameterLaw v) ≤ f (fourParameterLaw a) := by
      rw [four_parameter_polytope_hull] at hv
      have h := hMax (fourParameterLaw v) (four_parameter_law_feasible v hv)
      rwa [four_parameter_law_reconstruct q hq]
    have hVertex := strict_convex_hull_maximizer_in_generators fourParameterVertexSet
      (fun a => f (fourParameterLaw a)) hStrict a ha hMaxA
    have hqEq : fourParameterLaw a=q := four_parameter_law_reconstruct q hq
    rcases hVertex with ⟨i,b,hi⟩|⟨s,hs,hProd,hsEq⟩
    · have hModel : q=fourUniformLaw i b := by
        rw [hi,four_axis_vertex_law] at hqEq; exact hqEq.symm
      left; refine ⟨i,b,hModel,?_⟩
      have h := hMax (fourTranslatedLaw (fun _ => false)) (four_translated_feasible _)
      rwa [hModel,hU,hW] at h
    · obtain ⟨u,hu⟩ := four_weighted_vertex_law s hs hProd
      have hModel : q=fourTranslatedLaw u := by
        rw [hsEq,hu] at hqEq; exact hqEq.symm
      right; refine ⟨u,hModel,?_⟩
      have h := hMax (fourUniformLaw 0 false) (four_uniform_feasible 0 false)
      rwa [hModel,hU,hW] at h
  · rintro (⟨i,b,rfl,hLe⟩|⟨s,rfl,hLe⟩) v hv
    · have h := four_objective_upper_bound f hf U W hU hW v hv
      rw [max_eq_left hLe] at h
      simpa only [hU] using h
    · have h := four_objective_upper_bound f hf U W hU hW v hv
      rw [max_eq_right hLe] at h
      simpa only [hW] using h


noncomputable def entropyTransitionPhi (α : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (4/3:ℝ)^α+10*(2/3:ℝ)^α-8

theorem entropy_transition_derivative (x : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt entropyTransitionPhi
      ((4/3:ℝ)^x*Real.log (4/3)+10*((2/3:ℝ)^x*Real.log (2/3))) x := by
  exact (((Real.hasStrictDerivAt_const_rpow (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<4/3) x).hasDerivAt).add
    (((Real.hasStrictDerivAt_const_rpow (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<2/3) x).hasDerivAt).const_mul 10)).sub_const 8

theorem entropy_transition_strict_convex : StrictConvexOn ℝ Set.univ entropyTransitionPhi := by
  have hD : deriv entropyTransitionPhi=fun x =>
      (4/3:ℝ)^x*Real.log (4/3)+10*((2/3:ℝ)^x*Real.log (2/3)) := by
    funext x; exact (entropy_transition_derivative x).deriv
  apply strictConvexOn_univ_of_deriv2_pos (by unfold entropyTransitionPhi; fun_prop)
  intro x
  change 0<deriv (deriv entropyTransitionPhi) x
  rw [hD]
  have h1 := ((Real.hasStrictDerivAt_const_rpow (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<4/3) x).hasDerivAt).mul_const (Real.log (4/3))
  have h2 := (((Real.hasStrictDerivAt_const_rpow (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<2/3) x).hasDerivAt).mul_const (Real.log (2/3))).const_mul 10
  have hD2 : HasDerivAt
      (fun y : ℝ => (4/3:ℝ)^y*Real.log (4/3)+10*((2/3:ℝ)^y*Real.log (2/3)))
      ((4/3:ℝ)^x*Real.log (4/3)*Real.log (4/3)+
        10*((2/3:ℝ)^x*Real.log (2/3)*Real.log (2/3))) x := h1.add h2
  rw [hD2.deriv]
  have hLog : 0<Real.log (4/3:ℝ) := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hPos : 0<(4/3:ℝ)^x*Real.log (4/3)*Real.log (4/3) := by positivity
  have hNonneg : 0<=(10:ℝ)*((2/3:ℝ)^x*Real.log (2/3)*Real.log (2/3)) := by
    have hPow : 0<(2/3:ℝ)^x := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) x
    have hNN := mul_nonneg hPow.le (sq_nonneg (Real.log (2/3:ℝ)))
    nlinarith only [hNN]
  linarith

theorem entropy_transition_values : entropyTransitionPhi 1=0 ∧
    entropyTransitionPhi 6<0 ∧ 0<entropyTransitionPhi 7 := by
  norm_num [entropyTransitionPhi,Real.rpow_natCast]

theorem entropy_transition_unique_root :
    ∃ α : ℝ, 6<α ∧ α<7 ∧ entropyTransitionPhi α=0 ∧
      ∀ β : ℝ, entropyTransitionPhi β=0 → β=1 ∨ β=α := by
  have hc : Continuous entropyTransitionPhi := by unfold entropyTransitionPhi; fun_prop
  have hv := entropy_transition_values
  have hZero : (0:ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (entropyTransitionPhi 6) (entropyTransitionPhi 7) := ⟨hv.2.1.le,hv.2.2.le⟩
  obtain ⟨α,hα,hRoot⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc (by norm_num : (6:ℝ)≤7) hc.continuousOn hZero
  have h6 : 6<α := lt_of_le_of_ne hα.1 (by intro h; subst α; linarith)
  have h7 : α<7 := lt_of_le_of_ne hα.2 (by intro h; subst α; linarith)
  have hThree (x y z : ℝ) (hxy : x<y) (hyz : y<z)
      (hx : entropyTransitionPhi x=0) (hy : entropyTransitionPhi y=0)
      (hz : entropyTransitionPhi z=0) : False := by
    have hSeg : y∈openSegment ℝ x z := by
      rw [openSegment_eq_Ioo (lt_trans hxy hyz)]; exact ⟨hxy,hyz⟩
    have h := entropy_transition_strict_convex.lt_on_openSegment
      (Set.mem_univ x) (Set.mem_univ z) (ne_of_lt (lt_trans hxy hyz)) hSeg
    rw [hx,hy,hz,max_self] at h
    exact (lt_irrefl 0) h
  refine ⟨α,h6,h7,hRoot,?_⟩
  intro β hβ
  rcases lt_trichotomy β 1 with hβ1|hβ1|hβ1
  · exact False.elim (hThree β 1 α hβ1 (by linarith) hβ hv.1 hRoot)
  · exact Or.inl hβ1
  · rcases lt_trichotomy β α with hβα|hβα|hβα
    · exact False.elim (hThree 1 β α hβ1 hβα hv.1 hβ hRoot)
    · exact Or.inr hβα
    · exact False.elim (hThree 1 α β (by linarith) hβα hv.1 hRoot hβ)

theorem entropy_transition_sign_diagram {α : ℝ} (hα : 1<α)
    (hRoot : entropyTransitionPhi α=0) :
    (∀ β : ℝ, β<1 → 0<entropyTransitionPhi β) ∧
    (∀ β : ℝ, 1<β → β<α → entropyTransitionPhi β<0) ∧
    (∀ β : ℝ, α<β → 0<entropyTransitionPhi β) := by
  have hOne := entropy_transition_values.1
  refine ⟨?_,?_,?_⟩
  · intro β hβ
    by_contra hNot
    have hLe := le_of_not_gt hNot
    have hSeg : (1:ℝ)∈openSegment ℝ β α := by
      rw [openSegment_eq_Ioo (lt_trans hβ hα)]; exact ⟨hβ,hα⟩
    have h := entropy_transition_strict_convex.lt_on_openSegment
      (Set.mem_univ β) (Set.mem_univ α) (ne_of_lt (lt_trans hβ hα)) hSeg
    rw [hOne,hRoot] at h
    have hMax : max (entropyTransitionPhi β) 0 ≤ 0 := max_le hLe le_rfl
    linarith
  · intro β hβ hβα
    have hSeg : β∈openSegment ℝ 1 α := by rw [openSegment_eq_Ioo hα]; exact ⟨hβ,hβα⟩
    have h := entropy_transition_strict_convex.lt_on_openSegment
      (Set.mem_univ 1) (Set.mem_univ α) (ne_of_lt hα) hSeg
    simpa only [hOne,hRoot,max_self] using h
  · intro β hβ
    by_contra hNot
    have hLe := le_of_not_gt hNot
    have hSeg : α∈openSegment ℝ 1 β := by
      rw [openSegment_eq_Ioo (lt_trans hα hβ)]; exact ⟨hα,hβ⟩
    have h := entropy_transition_strict_convex.lt_on_openSegment
      (Set.mem_univ 1) (Set.mem_univ β) (ne_of_lt (lt_trans hα hβ)) hSeg
    rw [hOne,hRoot] at h
    have hMax : max 0 (entropyTransitionPhi β) ≤ 0 := max_le le_rfl hLe
    linarith

theorem four_power_value_difference (α : ℝ) :
    fourWeightedPowerValue α-fourUniformPowerValue α=(1/8:ℝ)^α*entropyTransitionPhi α := by
  have h6 : (1/6:ℝ)^α=(1/8:ℝ)^α*(4/3:ℝ)^α := by
    rw [← Real.mul_rpow (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)≤1/8) (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)≤4/3)]
    norm_num
  have h12 : (1/12:ℝ)^α=(1/8:ℝ)^α*(2/3:ℝ)^α := by
    rw [← Real.mul_rpow (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)≤1/8) (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)≤2/3)]
    norm_num
  unfold fourWeightedPowerValue fourUniformPowerValue entropyTransitionPhi
  rw [h6,h12]
  ring

theorem four_translated_shannon (s : Fin 4 → Bool) :
    shannon (fourTranslatedLaw s)=Real.log 12-Real.log 2/6 := by
  have h := four_translated_function_sum s (fun r => (r:ℝ)*Real.log (r:ℝ))
  norm_num at h
  have h12 : Real.log (12:ℝ)=Real.log 2+Real.log 6 := by
    have hh := Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (2:ℝ)≠0) (by norm_num : (6:ℝ)≠0)
    norm_num at hh
    exact hh
  have h6inv : Real.log (1/6:ℝ)= -Real.log 6 := by simp [one_div,Real.log_inv]
  have h12inv : Real.log (1/12:ℝ)= -Real.log 12 := by simp [one_div,Real.log_inv]
  rw [h6inv,h12inv] at h
  unfold shannon
  change -(∑ x, (fourTranslatedWeights s x:ℝ)*Real.log (fourTranslatedWeights s x:ℝ))=_
  rw [h]
  linarith

theorem four_uniform_shannon (i : Fin 5) (b : Bool) :
    shannon (fourUniformLaw i b)=Real.log 8 := by
  have h := four_uniform_function_sum i b (fun r => (r:ℝ)*Real.log (r:ℝ))
  norm_num at h
  have h8inv : Real.log (1/8:ℝ)= -Real.log 8 := by simp [one_div,Real.log_inv]
  rw [h8inv] at h
  unfold shannon
  change -(∑ x, (fourUniformWeights i b x:ℝ)*Real.log (fourUniformWeights i b x:ℝ))=_
  rw [h]
  ring

theorem probability_power_sum_pos {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (p : ι → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ x, 0 ≤ p x) (hm : (∑ x, p x)=1) (α : ℝ) : 0<∑ x, (p x)^α := by
  classical
  have hex : ∃ x, 0<p x := by
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    have hSum := Finset.sum_nonpos (fun x (_ : x∈Finset.univ) => h x)
    linarith
  obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ := hex
  exact Finset.sum_pos' (fun y _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (hp y) α)
    ⟨x,Finset.mem_univ x,Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hx α⟩

theorem renyi_comparison_gt_one {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (p q : ι → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ x, 0 ≤ p x) (hpm : (∑ x, p x)=1)
    (hq : ∀ x, 0 ≤ q x) (hqm : (∑ x, q x)=1) {α : ℝ} (hα : 1<α) :
    finiteRenyi α p ≤ finiteRenyi α q ↔ (∑ x, (q x)^α) ≤ ∑ x, (p x)^α := by
  unfold finiteRenyi
  simp only [if_neg (ne_of_gt hα)]
  have hDen : 1-α= -(α-1) := by ring
  rw [hDen,div_neg,div_neg,neg_le_neg_iff,
    div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right (sub_pos.mpr hα)]
  exact Real.log_le_log_iff (probability_power_sum_pos q hq hqm α)
    (probability_power_sum_pos p hp hpm α)

theorem renyi_comparison_lt_one {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (p q : ι → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ x, 0 ≤ p x) (hpm : (∑ x, p x)=1)
    (hq : ∀ x, 0 ≤ q x) (hqm : (∑ x, q x)=1) {α : ℝ} (hα : α<1) :
    finiteRenyi α p ≤ finiteRenyi α q ↔ (∑ x, (p x)^α) ≤ ∑ x, (q x)^α := by
  unfold finiteRenyi
  rw [if_neg (ne_of_lt hα),if_neg (ne_of_lt hα),
    div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right (by linarith : 0<1-α)]
  exact Real.log_le_log_iff (probability_power_sum_pos p hp hpm α)
    (probability_power_sum_pos q hq hqm α)

theorem four_uniform_renyi (i : Fin 5) (b : Bool) {α : ℝ} (hα : 0<α) :
    finiteRenyi α (fourUniformLaw i b)=Real.log 8 := by
  by_cases hOne : α=1
  · simp only [finiteRenyi,hOne,ite_true]
    exact four_uniform_shannon i b
  · rw [finiteRenyi,if_neg hOne,four_uniform_power_sum i b hα]
    rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (8:ℝ)≠0)
      (ne_of_gt (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1/8) α)),
      Real.log_rpow (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1/8) α]
    have hInv : Real.log (1/8:ℝ)= -Real.log 8 := by simp [one_div,Real.log_inv]
    rw [hInv]
    apply (div_eq_iff (sub_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm hOne))).mpr
    ring

theorem four_weighted_power_value_factorization (α : ℝ) :
    fourWeightedPowerValue α=(1/12:ℝ)^α*((2:ℝ)^α+10) := by
  have h6 : (1/6:ℝ)^α=(1/12:ℝ)^α*(2:ℝ)^α := by
    rw [← Real.mul_rpow (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)≤1/12) (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)≤2)]
    norm_num
  unfold fourWeightedPowerValue
  rw [h6]
  ring

theorem four_weighted_renyi (s : Fin 4 → Bool) {α : ℝ} (hα : 0<α) (hOne : α≠1) :
    finiteRenyi α (fourTranslatedLaw s)=
      (Real.log ((2:ℝ)^α+10)-α*Real.log 12)/(1-α) := by
  rw [finiteRenyi,if_neg hOne,four_translated_power_sum s hα]
  change Real.log (fourWeightedPowerValue α)/(1-α)=_
  rw [four_weighted_power_value_factorization]
  have hPos : 0<(2:ℝ)^α+10 := by positivity
  rw [Real.log_mul (ne_of_gt (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1/12) α))
      (ne_of_gt hPos),Real.log_rpow (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1/12) α]
  have hInv : Real.log (1/12:ℝ)= -Real.log 12 := by simp [one_div,Real.log_inv]
  rw [hInv]
  ring

theorem four_shannon_values_strict : Real.log 8<Real.log 12-Real.log 2/6 := by
  have h : Real.log ((2:ℝ)^7)<Real.log ((3:ℝ)^6) :=
    Real.log_lt_log (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  rw [Real.log_pow,Real.log_pow] at h
  norm_num at h
  have h12 : Real.log (12:ℝ)=Real.log 3+2*Real.log 2 := by
    have hh := Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (3:ℝ)≠0) (by norm_num : ((2:ℝ)^2)≠0)
    rw [Real.log_pow] at hh
    norm_num at hh
    exact hh
  have h8 : Real.log (8:ℝ)=3*Real.log 2 := by
    have hh := Real.log_pow (2:ℝ) 3
    norm_num at hh
    exact hh
  rw [h12,h8]
  linarith


theorem four_order_reversing_objective_minimizers
    (f g : ((Fin 4 → Bool) → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hf : StrictConvexOn ℝ {p : (Fin 4 → Bool) → ℝ | ∀ x, 0 ≤ p x} f)
    (U W A B : ℝ) (hU : ∀ i b, f (fourUniformLaw i b)=U)
    (hW : ∀ s, f (fourTranslatedLaw s)=W)
    (hA : ∀ i b, g (fourUniformLaw i b)=A)
    (hB : ∀ s, g (fourTranslatedLaw s)=B)
    (hOrder : ∀ p q, cubeProbabilityFeasible p → cubeProbabilityFeasible q →
      (g p ≤ g q ↔ f q ≤ f p))
    (q : (Fin 4 → Bool) → ℝ) (hq : cubeProbabilityFeasible q) :
    (∀ v : (Fin 4 → Bool) → ℝ, cubeProbabilityFeasible v → g q ≤ g v) ↔
      (∃ (i : Fin 5) (b : Bool), q=fourUniformLaw i b ∧ A ≤ B) ∨
      (∃ s : Fin 4 → Bool, q=fourTranslatedLaw s ∧ B ≤ A) := by
  have hOpt : (∀ v : (Fin 4 → Bool) → ℝ, cubeProbabilityFeasible v → g q ≤ g v) ↔
      (∀ v : (Fin 4 → Bool) → ℝ, cubeProbabilityFeasible v → f v ≤ f q) := by
    constructor
    · intro h v hv; exact (hOrder q v hq hv).mp (h v hv)
    · intro h v hv; exact (hOrder q v hq hv).mpr (h v hv)
  have hAB : (A ≤ B) ↔ W ≤ U := by
    have h := hOrder (fourUniformLaw 0 false) (fourTranslatedLaw (fun _ => false))
      (four_uniform_feasible 0 false) (four_translated_feasible _)
    simpa only [hA,hB,hU,hW] using h
  have hBA : (B ≤ A) ↔ U ≤ W := by
    have h := hOrder (fourTranslatedLaw (fun _ => false)) (fourUniformLaw 0 false)
      (four_translated_feasible _) (four_uniform_feasible 0 false)
    simpa only [hA,hB,hU,hW] using h
  rw [hOpt,four_objective_global_maximizers f hf U W hU hW q hq]
  simp only [hAB,hBA]
noncomputable def fourWeightedEntropyValue (α : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  if α=1 then Real.log 12-Real.log 2/6 else (Real.log ((2:ℝ)^α+10)-α*Real.log 12)/(1-α)

theorem four_weighted_entropy_value (s : Fin 4 → Bool) {α : ℝ} (hα : 0<α) :
    finiteRenyi α (fourTranslatedLaw s)=fourWeightedEntropyValue α := by
  by_cases hOne : α=1
  · simp only [finiteRenyi,fourWeightedEntropyValue,hOne,ite_true]
    exact four_translated_shannon s
  · rw [fourWeightedEntropyValue,if_neg hOne]
    exact four_weighted_renyi s hα hOne

theorem four_renyi_minimizers_values {α : ℝ} (hα : 0<α)
    (q : (Fin 4 → Bool) → ℝ) (hq : cubeProbabilityFeasible q) :
    (∀ v : (Fin 4 → Bool) → ℝ, cubeProbabilityFeasible v → finiteRenyi α q ≤ finiteRenyi α v) ↔
      (∃ (i : Fin 5) (b : Bool), q=fourUniformLaw i b ∧ Real.log 8 ≤ fourWeightedEntropyValue α) ∨
      (∃ s : Fin 4 → Bool, q=fourTranslatedLaw s ∧ fourWeightedEntropyValue α ≤ Real.log 8) := by
  rcases lt_trichotomy α 1 with hLt|hEq|hGt
  · apply four_order_reversing_objective_minimizers
      (fun p : (Fin 4 → Bool) → ℝ => -(∑ x, (p x)^α)) (finiteRenyi α)
      (finite_negative_power_sum_strict_convex hα hLt)
      (-fourUniformPowerValue α) (-fourWeightedPowerValue α) (Real.log 8) (fourWeightedEntropyValue α)
    · intro i b; rw [four_uniform_power_sum i b hα]; rfl
    · intro s; rw [four_translated_power_sum s hα]; rfl
    · exact fun i b => four_uniform_renyi i b hα
    · exact fun s => four_weighted_entropy_value s hα
    · intro p v hp hv
      simpa only [neg_le_neg_iff] using renyi_comparison_lt_one p v hp.1 hp.2.1 hv.1 hv.2.1 hLt
    · exact hq
  · subst α
    apply four_order_reversing_objective_minimizers
      (fun p : (Fin 4 → Bool) → ℝ => ∑ x, p x*Real.log (p x)) (finiteRenyi 1)
      finite_negative_shannon_strict_convex
      (-Real.log 8) (-(Real.log 12-Real.log 2/6)) (Real.log 8) (fourWeightedEntropyValue 1)
    · intro i b; have h := four_uniform_shannon i b; unfold shannon at h; linarith
    · intro s; have h := four_translated_shannon s; unfold shannon at h; linarith
    · exact fun i b => four_uniform_renyi i b (by norm_num)
    · exact fun s => four_weighted_entropy_value s (by norm_num)
    · intro p v _ _
      simp only [finiteRenyi,ite_true,shannon,neg_le_neg_iff]
    · exact hq
  · apply four_order_reversing_objective_minimizers
      (fun p : (Fin 4 → Bool) → ℝ => ∑ x, (p x)^α) (finiteRenyi α)
      (finite_power_sum_strict_convex hGt)
      (fourUniformPowerValue α) (fourWeightedPowerValue α) (Real.log 8) (fourWeightedEntropyValue α)
    · intro i b; exact four_uniform_power_sum i b hα
    · intro s; exact four_translated_power_sum s hα
    · exact fun i b => four_uniform_renyi i b hα
    · exact fun s => four_weighted_entropy_value s hα
    · intro p v hp hv
      exact renyi_comparison_gt_one p v hp.1 hp.2.1 hv.1 hv.2.1 hGt
    · exact hq

theorem four_entropy_value_comparison_gt_one {α : ℝ} (hα : 1<α) :
    (Real.log 8 ≤ fourWeightedEntropyValue α ↔ fourWeightedPowerValue α ≤ fourUniformPowerValue α) ∧
    (fourWeightedEntropyValue α ≤ Real.log 8 ↔ fourUniformPowerValue α ≤ fourWeightedPowerValue α) := by
  have hU := four_uniform_feasible 0 false
  have hW := four_translated_feasible (fun _ => false)
  have hPos : 0<α := lt_trans zero_lt_one hα
  constructor
  · have h := renyi_comparison_gt_one (fourUniformLaw 0 false) (fourTranslatedLaw (fun _ => false))
      hU.1 hU.2.1 hW.1 hW.2.1 hα
    simpa only [four_uniform_renyi 0 false hPos,four_weighted_entropy_value _ hPos,
      four_uniform_power_sum 0 false hPos,four_translated_power_sum _ hPos,
      fourUniformPowerValue,fourWeightedPowerValue] using h
  · have h := renyi_comparison_gt_one (fourTranslatedLaw (fun _ => false)) (fourUniformLaw 0 false)
      hW.1 hW.2.1 hU.1 hU.2.1 hα
    simpa only [four_uniform_renyi 0 false hPos,four_weighted_entropy_value _ hPos,
      four_uniform_power_sum 0 false hPos,four_translated_power_sum _ hPos,
      fourUniformPowerValue,fourWeightedPowerValue] using h

theorem four_entropy_value_comparison_lt_one {α : ℝ} (hPos : 0<α) (hα : α<1) :
    (Real.log 8 ≤ fourWeightedEntropyValue α ↔ fourUniformPowerValue α ≤ fourWeightedPowerValue α) ∧
    (fourWeightedEntropyValue α ≤ Real.log 8 ↔ fourWeightedPowerValue α ≤ fourUniformPowerValue α) := by
  have hU := four_uniform_feasible 0 false
  have hW := four_translated_feasible (fun _ => false)
  constructor
  · have h := renyi_comparison_lt_one (fourUniformLaw 0 false) (fourTranslatedLaw (fun _ => false))
      hU.1 hU.2.1 hW.1 hW.2.1 hα
    simpa only [four_uniform_renyi 0 false hPos,four_weighted_entropy_value _ hPos,
      four_uniform_power_sum 0 false hPos,four_translated_power_sum _ hPos,
      fourUniformPowerValue,fourWeightedPowerValue] using h
  · have h := renyi_comparison_lt_one (fourTranslatedLaw (fun _ => false)) (fourUniformLaw 0 false)
      hW.1 hW.2.1 hU.1 hU.2.1 hα
    simpa only [four_uniform_renyi 0 false hPos,four_weighted_entropy_value _ hPos,
      four_uniform_power_sum 0 false hPos,four_translated_power_sum _ hPos,
      fourUniformPowerValue,fourWeightedPowerValue] using h

theorem four_entropy_value_phase {τ : ℝ} (hτ : 1<τ) (hRoot : entropyTransitionPhi τ=0)
    {α : ℝ} (hPos : 0<α) :
    (α<τ → Real.log 8<fourWeightedEntropyValue α) ∧
    (α=τ → Real.log 8=fourWeightedEntropyValue α) ∧
    (τ<α → fourWeightedEntropyValue α<Real.log 8) := by
  have hSign := entropy_transition_sign_diagram hτ hRoot
  have hPow : 0<(1/8:ℝ)^α := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) α
  have hDiff := four_power_value_difference α
  rcases lt_trichotomy α 1 with hLt|hEq|hGt
  · have hφ := hSign.1 α hLt
    have hUW : fourUniformPowerValue α<fourWeightedPowerValue α := by
      nlinarith [mul_pos hPow hφ]
    have hCmp := four_entropy_value_comparison_lt_one hPos hLt
    have hStrict : Real.log 8<fourWeightedEntropyValue α :=
      lt_of_not_ge (fun h => not_le_of_gt hUW (hCmp.2.mp h))
    exact ⟨fun _ => hStrict,fun h => False.elim (by linarith),fun h => False.elim (by linarith)⟩
  · subst α
    have hStrict : Real.log 8<fourWeightedEntropyValue 1 := by
      simpa only [fourWeightedEntropyValue,ite_true] using four_shannon_values_strict
    exact ⟨fun _ => hStrict,fun h => False.elim (by linarith),fun h => False.elim (by linarith)⟩
  · have hCmp := four_entropy_value_comparison_gt_one hGt
    refine ⟨?_,?_,?_⟩
    · intro hατ
      have hφ := hSign.2.1 α hGt hατ
      have hWU : fourWeightedPowerValue α<fourUniformPowerValue α := by
        nlinarith [mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg hPow hφ]
      exact lt_of_not_ge (fun h => not_le_of_gt hWU (hCmp.2.mp h))
    · intro hατ
      have hφ : entropyTransitionPhi α=0 := by rw [hατ]; exact hRoot
      have hEq : fourWeightedPowerValue α=fourUniformPowerValue α := by rw [hφ,mul_zero] at hDiff; linarith
      exact le_antisymm (hCmp.1.mpr hEq.le) (hCmp.2.mpr hEq.ge)
    · intro hτα
      have hφ := hSign.2.2 α hτα
      have hUW : fourUniformPowerValue α<fourWeightedPowerValue α := by
        nlinarith [mul_pos hPow hφ]
      exact lt_of_not_ge (fun h => not_le_of_gt hUW (hCmp.1.mp h))

theorem four_renyi_minimum_value {α : ℝ} (hα : 0<α) :
    ∃ q : (Fin 4 → Bool) → ℝ, cubeProbabilityFeasible q ∧
      finiteRenyi α q=min (Real.log 8) (fourWeightedEntropyValue α) ∧
      ∀ v : (Fin 4 → Bool) → ℝ, cubeProbabilityFeasible v → finiteRenyi α q ≤ finiteRenyi α v := by
  by_cases hLe : Real.log 8 ≤ fourWeightedEntropyValue α
  · refine ⟨fourUniformLaw 0 false,four_uniform_feasible 0 false,?_,?_⟩
    · rw [four_uniform_renyi 0 false hα,min_eq_left hLe]
    · apply (four_renyi_minimizers_values hα _ (four_uniform_feasible 0 false)).mpr
      exact Or.inl ⟨0,false,rfl,hLe⟩
  · have hLe' := le_of_not_ge hLe
    refine ⟨fourTranslatedLaw (fun _ => false),four_translated_feasible _,?_,?_⟩
    · rw [four_weighted_entropy_value _ hα,min_eq_right hLe']
    · apply (four_renyi_minimizers_values hα _ (four_translated_feasible _)).mpr
      exact Or.inr ⟨_,rfl,hLe'⟩

def fourUniformFamily (q : (Fin 4 → Bool) → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (i : Fin 5) (b : Bool), q=fourUniformLaw i b
def fourWeightedFamily (q : (Fin 4 → Bool) → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ s : Fin 4 → Bool, q=fourTranslatedLaw s
noncomputable def IsCubeRenyiGlobalMin (α : ℝ) (q : (Fin 4 → Bool) → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ v : (Fin 4 → Bool) → ℝ, cubeProbabilityFeasible v → finiteRenyi α q ≤ finiteRenyi α v

theorem four_renyi_phase_selector {τ : ℝ} (hτ : 1<τ) (hRoot : entropyTransitionPhi τ=0)
    {α : ℝ} (hα : 0<α) (q : (Fin 4 → Bool) → ℝ) (hq : cubeProbabilityFeasible q) :
    IsCubeRenyiGlobalMin α q ↔
      if α<τ then fourUniformFamily q else if τ<α then fourWeightedFamily q else
        fourUniformFamily q ∨ fourWeightedFamily q := by
  rw [IsCubeRenyiGlobalMin,four_renyi_minimizers_values hα q hq]
  have hPhase := four_entropy_value_phase hτ hRoot hα
  by_cases hLt : α<τ
  · rw [if_pos hLt]
    have hStrict := hPhase.1 hLt
    constructor
    · rintro (⟨i,b,hEq,_⟩|⟨s,hEq,hBad⟩)
      · exact ⟨i,b,hEq⟩
      · exact False.elim (not_le_of_gt hStrict hBad)
    · rintro ⟨i,b,hEq⟩
      exact Or.inl ⟨i,b,hEq,hStrict.le⟩
  · rw [if_neg hLt]
    by_cases hGt : τ<α
    · rw [if_pos hGt]
      have hStrict := hPhase.2.2 hGt
      constructor
      · rintro (⟨i,b,hEq,hBad⟩|⟨s,hEq,_⟩)
        · exact False.elim (not_le_of_gt hStrict hBad)
        · exact ⟨s,hEq⟩
      · rintro ⟨s,hEq⟩
        exact Or.inr ⟨s,hEq,hStrict.le⟩
    · rw [if_neg hGt]
      have hEq : α=τ := by linarith
      have hValues := hPhase.2.1 hEq
      constructor
      · rintro (⟨i,b,hModel,_⟩|⟨s,hModel,_⟩)
        · exact Or.inl ⟨i,b,hModel⟩
        · exact Or.inr ⟨s,hModel⟩
      · rintro (⟨i,b,hModel⟩|⟨s,hModel⟩)
        · exact Or.inl ⟨i,b,hModel,hValues.le⟩
        · exact Or.inr ⟨s,hModel,hValues.ge⟩

theorem four_bit_entropy_global_phase :
    ∃ τ : ℝ, 6<τ ∧ τ<7 ∧ entropyTransitionPhi τ=0 ∧
      (∀ β : ℝ, 1<β → entropyTransitionPhi β=0 → β=τ) ∧
      ∀ α : ℝ, 0<α → ∀ q : (Fin 4 → Bool) → ℝ, cubeProbabilityFeasible q →
        (IsCubeRenyiGlobalMin α q ↔
          if α<τ then fourUniformFamily q else if τ<α then fourWeightedFamily q else
            fourUniformFamily q ∨ fourWeightedFamily q) := by
  obtain ⟨τ,h6,h7,hRoot,hOnly⟩ := entropy_transition_unique_root
  refine ⟨τ,h6,h7,hRoot,?_,?_⟩
  · intro β hβ hZero
    rcases hOnly β hZero with hOne|hτ
    · exact False.elim (by linarith)
    · exact hτ
  · intro α hα q hq
    exact four_renyi_phase_selector (by linarith) hRoot hα q hq

theorem gradient_dual_interpolation_strict_tangent {ι α : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype α]

    (hZero : ∀ x, p x=0 → g x=0)
    (hEqual : ∀ x, p x≠0 → dualMomentValues A y x=g x)
    (hOutside : ∀ x, p x=0 → 0<dualMomentValues A y x)
    (hInterpolation : ∀ x, p x≠0 → ∀ t, p t≠0 → (∑ i, L x i*A i t)=if t=x then 1 else 0) :
    ∀ z∈momentTangentCone A p, z≠0 → lawOverlap g z<0 := by
  classical
  intro z hz hz0
  have hTerm (x : α) : 0 ≤ (dualMomentValues A y x-g x)*z x := by
    by_cases hx : p x=0
    · rw [hZero x hx,sub_zero]
      exact mul_nonneg (hOutside x hx).le (hz.2.2 x hx)
    · rw [hEqual x hx,sub_self,zero_mul]
  have hSumNonneg : 0 ≤ ∑ x, (dualMomentValues A y x-g x)*z x :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun x _ => hTerm x)
  have hId := dualMomentValues_pairing A y z
  rw [hz.1] at hId
  simp only [Pi.zero_apply,mul_zero,Finset.sum_const_zero] at hId
  have hGap : (∑ x, (dualMomentValues A y x-g x)*z x)= -lawOverlap g z := by
    simp only [sub_mul,Finset.sum_sub_distrib,hId,zero_sub,lawOverlap]
  by_contra hNot
  have hNonneg : 0 ≤ lawOverlap g z := le_of_not_gt hNot
  have hSumZero : (∑ x, (dualMomentValues A y x-g x)*z x)=0 := by linarith
  have hSupport (x : α) (hx : p x=0) : z x=0 := by
    have hSingle := Finset.single_le_sum (fun t (_ : t∈Finset.univ) => hTerm t) (Finset.mem_univ x)
    rw [hSumZero,hZero x hx,sub_zero] at hSingle
    have hMul : dualMomentValues A y x*z x=0 :=
      le_antisymm hSingle (by simpa only [hZero x hx,sub_zero] using hTerm x)
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hMul).resolve_left (hOutside x hx).ne'
  exact hz0 (interpolated_supported_kernel_zero A p L hInterpolation z hz.1 hSupport)

noncomputable def fourGradientDual (s : Fin 4 → Bool) (u v : ℝ) (r : SmallTrapMomentIndex 4) : ℝ :=
  v*(fourConstantDual r : ℝ)+(u-v)*(fourQuadraticDual s r : ℝ)

theorem four_gradient_dual_value (s x : Fin 4 → Bool) (u v : ℝ) :
    dualMomentValues (cubeProbabilityMomentMatrix 4) (fourGradientDual s u v) x=
      v+(u-v)*(if fourTranslatedWeights s x=1/6 then 1 else
        if fourTranslatedWeights s x=1/12 then 0 else 1/3) := by
  have hC : (∑ r, (fourConstantDual r : ℝ)*cubeProbabilityMomentMatrix 4 r x)=1 := by
    have h := congrArg (fun q : ℚ => (q:ℝ)) (four_constant_dual_certificate x)
    push_cast at h
    simpa only [rationalTrapMomentMatrix_real] using h
  have hQ : (∑ r, (fourQuadraticDual s r : ℝ)*cubeProbabilityMomentMatrix 4 r x)=
      if fourTranslatedWeights s x=1/6 then 1 else if fourTranslatedWeights s x=1/12 then 0 else 1/3 := by
    have hCast (v : ℚ) (hRat : (∑ r, fourQuadraticDual s r*rationalTrapMomentMatrix 4 r x)=v) :
        (∑ r, (fourQuadraticDual s r : ℝ)*cubeProbabilityMomentMatrix 4 r x)=(v:ℝ) := by
      have h := congrArg (fun q : ℚ => (q:ℝ)) hRat
      push_cast at h
      simpa only [rationalTrapMomentMatrix_real] using h
    have hRat := four_quadratic_dual_certificate s x
    split_ifs with h6 h12
    · rw [if_pos h6] at hRat
      convert hCast 1 hRat using 1 <;> norm_num
    · rw [if_neg h6,if_pos h12] at hRat
      convert hCast 0 hRat using 1 <;> norm_num
    · rw [if_neg h6,if_neg h12] at hRat
      convert hCast (1/3) hRat using 1 <;> norm_num
  unfold dualMomentValues fourGradientDual
  simp only [add_mul,mul_assoc,Finset.sum_add_distrib,← Finset.mul_sum,hC,hQ,mul_one]

theorem four_translated_interpolation_real (s x t : Fin 4 → Bool)
    (hx : fourTranslatedLaw s x≠0) (ht : fourTranslatedLaw s t≠0) :
    (∑ r, (fourTranslatedInterpolation s x r : ℝ)*cubeProbabilityMomentMatrix 4 r t)=
      if t=x then 1 else 0 := by
  have hxQ : fourTranslatedWeights s x≠0 := by
    change (fourTranslatedWeights s x : ℝ)≠0 at hx
    exact_mod_cast hx
  have htQ : fourTranslatedWeights s t≠0 := by
    change (fourTranslatedWeights s t : ℝ)≠0 at ht
    exact_mod_cast ht
  have h := congrArg (fun q : ℚ => (q:ℝ)) (four_gradient_interpolation_certificate s x t hxQ htQ)
  push_cast at h
  simp only [rationalTrapMomentMatrix_real] at h
  by_cases hxt : t=x <;> simp [hxt] at h ⊢ <;> exact h

theorem four_translated_power_gradient_strict (s : Fin 4 → Bool) {r : ℝ} (hr : 1<r) :
    ∀ z∈momentTangentCone (cubeProbabilityMomentMatrix 4) (fourTranslatedLaw s), z≠0 →
      lawOverlap (fun x => (fourTranslatedLaw s x)^(r-1)) z<0 := by
  let u : ℝ := (1/6:ℝ)^(r-1)
  let v : ℝ := (1/12:ℝ)^(r-1)
  have hv : 0<v := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _
  have huv : v<u := Real.rpow_lt_rpow (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (sub_pos.mpr hr)
  apply gradient_dual_interpolation_strict_tangent (cubeProbabilityMomentMatrix 4)
    (fourTranslatedLaw s) (fun x => (fourTranslatedLaw s x)^(r-1))
    (fourGradientDual s u v) (fun x r => (fourTranslatedInterpolation s x r : ℝ))
  · intro x hx
    rw [hx,Real.zero_rpow (sub_pos.mpr hr).ne']
  · intro x hx
    rw [four_gradient_dual_value]
    rcases (four_translated_certificate s).1 x with hNonneg
    rcases (four_translated_weight_profile_certificate s).1 x with h0|h6|h12
    · have h0R : fourTranslatedLaw s x=0 := by unfold fourTranslatedLaw; rw [h0]; norm_num
      exact False.elim (hx h0R)
    · simp only [h6,ite_true,one_mul,mul_one]
      unfold fourTranslatedLaw
      rw [h6]
      norm_num
      dsimp [u]
    · simp only [h12]
      unfold fourTranslatedLaw
      rw [h12]
      norm_num
      rfl
  · intro x hx
    have hxQ : fourTranslatedWeights s x=0 := by
      change (fourTranslatedWeights s x : ℝ)=0 at hx
      exact_mod_cast hx
    rw [four_gradient_dual_value,hxQ]
    norm_num
    linarith
  · intro x hx t ht
    exact four_translated_interpolation_real s x t hx ht


theorem differentiable_strict_moment_tangent_local {ι α : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype α]
    [DecidableEq α] (A : Matrix ι α ℝ) (b : ι → ℝ) (p : α → ℝ)
    (hp : feasibleLaw A b p) (f : (α → ℝ) → ℝ) (L : StrongDual ℝ (α → ℝ))
    (hDeriv : HasFDerivAt f L p)
    (hStrict : ∀ z∈momentTangentCone A p, z≠0 → L z<0) :
    IsLocalMaxOn f {q | feasibleLaw A b q} p ∧
      ∃ ε : ℝ, 0<ε ∧ ∀ q, feasibleLaw A b q → q≠p → ‖q-p‖<ε → f q<f p := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨a,ha,hMargin⟩ := closed_cone_strict_linear_margin (momentTangentCone A p)
    (momentTangentCone_closed A p) (fun z hz t ht => momentTangentCone_smul A p z hz t ht) L hStrict
  obtain ⟨ε,hε,hR⟩ : ∃ ε>0, ∀ q∈Metric.ball p ε,
      ‖f q-f p-L (q-p)‖ ≤ (a/2)*‖q-p‖ :=
    Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp (hDeriv.isLittleO.bound (half_pos ha))
  have hDiff (q : α → ℝ) (hq : feasibleLaw A b q) : q-p∈momentTangentCone A p := by
    refine ⟨?_,?_,?_⟩
    · rw [Matrix.mulVec_sub,hq.2.2,hp.2.2,sub_self]
    · simp only [Pi.sub_apply,Finset.sum_sub_distrib,hq.2.1,hp.2.1,sub_self]
    · intro i hi; simpa only [Pi.sub_apply,hi,sub_zero] using hq.1 i
  have hStrictLocal (q : α → ℝ) (hq : feasibleLaw A b q) (hqp : q≠p) (hClose : ‖q-p‖<ε) :
      f q<f p := by
    have hM := hMargin (q-p) (hDiff q hq)
    have hRem := hR q (by simpa only [Metric.mem_ball,dist_eq_norm] using hClose)
    have hNorm : 0<‖q-p‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr hqp)
    have hUpper := (le_abs_self (f q-f p-L (q-p))).trans
      (by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hRem)
    nlinarith [mul_pos ha hNorm]
  refine ⟨?_,ε,hε,hStrictLocal⟩
  have hBall : ∀ᶠ q : α → ℝ in 𝓝 p, ‖q-p‖<ε := by
    simpa only [Filter.Eventually,Metric.ball,dist_eq_norm] using Metric.ball_mem_nhds p hε
  have hMem : ∀ᶠ q : α → ℝ in 𝓝[{q | feasibleLaw A b q}] p, feasibleLaw A b q := self_mem_nhdsWithin
  filter_upwards [nhdsWithin_le_nhds hBall,hMem] with q hClose hq
  by_cases hqp : q=p
  · subst q; exact le_rfl
  · exact (hStrictLocal q hq hqp hClose).le


noncomputable def finitePowerDerivative {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (r : ℝ) (p : α → ℝ) :
    StrongDual ℝ (α → ℝ) :=
  ∑ x : α, (r*(p x)^(r-1)) • ContinuousLinearMap.proj x

theorem finite_power_sum_hasFDerivAt {α : Type*} [Fintype α] {r : ℝ} (hr : 1<r) (p : α → ℝ) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun q : α → ℝ => ∑ x, (q x)^r) (finitePowerDerivative r p) p := by
  classical
  have h (x : α) : HasFDerivAt (fun q : α → ℝ => (q x)^r)
      ((r*(p x)^(r-1)) • (ContinuousLinearMap.proj x : StrongDual ℝ (α → ℝ))) p := by
    let P : StrongDual ℝ (α → ℝ) := ContinuousLinearMap.proj x
    have hP : HasFDerivAt (fun q : α → ℝ => q x) P p := P.hasFDerivAt
    have hh := (Real.hasDerivAt_rpow_const (Or.inr hr.le) (x := p x)).comp_hasFDerivAt p hP
    simpa only [P,Function.comp_def] using hh
  have hSum := HasFDerivAt.sum (fun x (_ : x∈Finset.univ) => h x)
  have hFn : (∑ i : α, fun q : α → ℝ => (q i)^r)=(fun q : α → ℝ => ∑ i, (q i)^r) := by
    funext q
    simp
  rw [hFn] at hSum
  exact hSum

theorem finite_power_derivative_apply {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (r : ℝ) (p z : α → ℝ) :
    finitePowerDerivative r p z=r*lawOverlap (fun x => (p x)^(r-1)) z := by
  simp [finitePowerDerivative,lawOverlap,Finset.mul_sum,mul_assoc]

theorem four_translated_power_strict_local (s : Fin 4 → Bool) {r : ℝ} (hr : 1<r) :
    IsLocalMaxOn (fun q : (Fin 4 → Bool) → ℝ => ∑ x, (q x)^r)
      {q | cubeProbabilityFeasible q} (fourTranslatedLaw s) ∧
    ∃ ε : ℝ, 0<ε ∧ ∀ q : (Fin 4 → Bool) → ℝ,
      cubeProbabilityFeasible q → q≠fourTranslatedLaw s → ‖q-fourTranslatedLaw s‖<ε →
      (∑ x, (q x)^r)<∑ x, (fourTranslatedLaw s x)^r := by
  have hP := (cube_probability_feasible_iff _).mp (four_translated_feasible s)
  have hStrict (z : (Fin 4 → Bool) → ℝ)
      (hz : z∈momentTangentCone (cubeProbabilityMomentMatrix 4) (fourTranslatedLaw s)) (hz0 : z≠0) :
      finitePowerDerivative r (fourTranslatedLaw s) z<0 := by
    rw [finite_power_derivative_apply]
    exact mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg (lt_trans zero_lt_one hr)
      (four_translated_power_gradient_strict s hr z hz hz0)
  obtain ⟨hLocal,ε,hε,hBound⟩ := differentiable_strict_moment_tangent_local
    (cubeProbabilityMomentMatrix 4) (cubeProbabilityMomentTarget 4) (fourTranslatedLaw s) hP
    (fun q : (Fin 4 → Bool) → ℝ => ∑ x, (q x)^r) (finitePowerDerivative r (fourTranslatedLaw s))
    (finite_power_sum_hasFDerivAt hr _) hStrict
  have hSet : {q | feasibleLaw (cubeProbabilityMomentMatrix 4) (cubeProbabilityMomentTarget 4) q}=
      {q : (Fin 4 → Bool) → ℝ | cubeProbabilityFeasible q} := by
    ext q; exact (cube_probability_feasible_iff q).symm
  rw [hSet] at hLocal
  exact ⟨hLocal,ε,hε,fun q hq => hBound q ((cube_probability_feasible_iff q).mp hq)⟩


def fourUniformInterpolationWeight (i : Fin 5) : SmallTrapMomentIndex 4 → ℚ :=
  Sum.elim (fun _ => 1/8)
    (Sum.elim (fun j => if i.val=4 ∨ j.val=i.val then 1/8 else 1/16)
      (fun jk => if jk.1 < jk.2 then
        if i.val≠4 ∧ (jk.1.val=i.val ∨ jk.2.val=i.val) then 1/8 else 1/16 else 0))

def fourUniformInterpolation (i : Fin 5) (x : Fin 4 → Bool) (r : SmallTrapMomentIndex 4) : ℚ :=
  fourUniformInterpolationWeight i r*rationalTrapMomentMatrix 4 r x

theorem four_uniform_interpolation_certificate : ∀ (i : Fin 5) (b : Bool) (x t : Fin 4 → Bool),
    fourUniformWeights i b x≠0 → fourUniformWeights i b t≠0 →
    (∑ r, fourUniformInterpolation i x r*rationalTrapMomentMatrix 4 r t)=if t=x then 1 else 0 := by

theorem four_uniform_interpolation_real (i : Fin 5) (b : Bool) (x t : Fin 4 → Bool)
    (hx : fourUniformLaw i b x≠0) (ht : fourUniformLaw i b t≠0) :
    (∑ r, (fourUniformInterpolation i x r : ℝ)*cubeProbabilityMomentMatrix 4 r t)=

  have htQ : fourUniformWeights i b t≠0 := by
    change (fourUniformWeights i b t : ℝ)≠0 at ht; exact_mod_cast ht

  simp only [rationalTrapMomentMatrix_real] at h

theorem four_uniform_power_gradient_strict (i : Fin 5) (b : Bool) {r : ℝ} (hr : 1<r) :
    ∀ z∈momentTangentCone (cubeProbabilityMomentMatrix 4) (fourUniformLaw i b), z≠0 →
      lawOverlap (fun x => (fourUniformLaw i b x)^(r-1)) z<0 := by
  let c : ℝ := (1/8:ℝ)^(r-1)

  have hValue (x : Fin 4 → Bool) :
      dualMomentValues (cubeProbabilityMomentMatrix 4) (fourGradientDual (fun _ => false) c c) x=c := by
    rw [four_gradient_dual_value]; simp
  apply gradient_dual_interpolation_strict_tangent (cubeProbabilityMomentMatrix 4)
    (fourUniformLaw i b) (fun x => (fourUniformLaw i b x)^(r-1))
    (fourGradientDual (fun _ => false) c c) (fun x r => (fourUniformInterpolation i x r : ℝ))
  · intro x hx; rw [hx,Real.zero_rpow (sub_pos.mpr hr).ne']
  · intro x hx
    rw [hValue]
    rcases (four_uniform_weight_profile_certificate i b).1 x with h0|h8
    · have h0R : fourUniformLaw i b x=0 := by unfold fourUniformLaw; rw [h0]; norm_num
      exact False.elim (hx h0R)
    · unfold fourUniformLaw
      rw [h8]
      norm_num
      rfl
  · intro x _; rw [hValue]; exact hc
  · intro x hx t ht; exact four_uniform_interpolation_real i b x t hx ht

theorem four_uniform_power_strict_local (i : Fin 5) (b : Bool) {r : ℝ} (hr : 1<r) :
    IsLocalMaxOn (fun q : (Fin 4 → Bool) → ℝ => ∑ x, (q x)^r)
      {q | cubeProbabilityFeasible q} (fourUniformLaw i b) ∧
    ∃ ε : ℝ, 0<ε ∧ ∀ q : (Fin 4 → Bool) → ℝ,

      (four_uniform_power_gradient_strict i b hr z hz hz0)
  obtain ⟨hLocal,ε,hε,hBound⟩ := differentiable_strict_moment_tangent_local
    (cubeProbabilityMomentMatrix 4) (cubeProbabilityMomentTarget 4) (fourUniformLaw i b) hP
    (fun q : (Fin 4 → Bool) → ℝ => ∑ x, (q x)^r) (finitePowerDerivative r (fourUniformLaw i b))
    (finite_power_sum_hasFDerivAt hr _) hStrict
  have hSet : {q | feasibleLaw (cubeProbabilityMomentMatrix 4) (cubeProbabilityMomentTarget 4) q}=

  exact ⟨hLocal,ε,hε,fun q hq => hBound q ((cube_probability_feasible_iff q).mp hq)⟩


theorem renyi_lt_of_power_sum_lt {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (p q : ι → ℝ)
    (hq : ∀ x, 0 ≤ q x) (hqm : (∑ x, q x)=1) {r : ℝ} (hr : 1<r)
    (hPower : (∑ x, (q x)^r)<∑ x, (p x)^r) : finiteRenyi r p<finiteRenyi r q := by
  unfold finiteRenyi
  simp only [if_neg (ne_of_gt hr)]
  have hDen : 1-r= -(r-1) := by ring
  rw [hDen,div_neg,div_neg,neg_lt_neg_iff,div_lt_div_iff_of_pos_right (sub_pos.mpr hr)]
  exact Real.log_lt_log (probability_power_sum_pos q hq hqm r) hPower

noncomputable def IsStrictCubeRenyiLocalMin (r : ℝ) (p : (Fin 4 → Bool) → ℝ) : Prop :=

theorem power_strict_local_to_cube_renyi {r : ℝ} (hr : 1<r)
    (p : (Fin 4 → Bool) → ℝ)
    (hPower : ∃ ε : ℝ, 0<ε ∧ ∀ q : (Fin 4 → Bool) → ℝ,
      cubeProbabilityFeasible q → q≠p → ‖q-p‖<ε → (∑ x, (q x)^r)<∑ x, (p x)^r) :

  have hStrict (q : (Fin 4 → Bool) → ℝ) (hq : cubeProbabilityFeasible q) (hqp : q≠p)
      (hClose : ‖q-p‖<ε) : finiteRenyi r p<finiteRenyi r q :=
    renyi_lt_of_power_sum_lt p q hq.1 hq.2.1 hr (hBound q hq hqp hClose)

  have hBall : ∀ᶠ q : (Fin 4 → Bool) → ℝ in 𝓝 p, ‖q-p‖<ε := by

  have hMem : ∀ᶠ q : (Fin 4 → Bool) → ℝ in 𝓝[{q | cubeProbabilityFeasible q}] p,
      cubeProbabilityFeasible q := self_mem_nhdsWithin
  filter_upwards [nhdsWithin_le_nhds hBall,hMem] with q hClose hq
  by_cases hqp : q=p
  · subst q; exact le_rfl
  · exact (hStrict q hq hqp hClose).le

theorem four_bit_renyi_local_persistence {r : ℝ} (hr : 1<r) :
    (∀ (i : Fin 5) (b : Bool), IsStrictCubeRenyiLocalMin r (fourUniformLaw i b)) ∧
    (∀ s : Fin 4 → Bool, IsStrictCubeRenyiLocalMin r (fourTranslatedLaw s)) := by

  · intro i b

theorem four_weighted_renyi_continuous_extension :
    Tendsto (fun α : ℝ => (Real.log ((2:ℝ)^α+10)-α*Real.log 12)/(1-α))
      (𝓝[≠] (1:ℝ)) (𝓝 (Real.log 12-Real.log 2/6)) := by
  let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun α => Real.log ((2:ℝ)^α+10)-α*Real.log 12
  have hPow : HasDerivAt (fun α : ℝ => (2:ℝ)^α) (2*Real.log 2) 1 := by
    simpa using (Real.hasStrictDerivAt_const_rpow (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<2) 1).hasDerivAt
  have hLog := (hPow.add_const 10).log (by norm_num : (2:ℝ)^(1:ℝ)+10≠0)
  have hD : HasDerivAt g (Real.log 2/6-Real.log 12) 1 := by
    have h := hLog.sub ((hasDerivAt_id (1:ℝ)).mul_const (Real.log 12))
    have hFn : ((fun y : ℝ => Real.log ((2:ℝ)^y+10))-(fun y : ℝ => id y*Real.log 12))=g := by
      funext y; rfl
    rw [hFn] at h
    convert h using 1 <;> norm_num <;> ring
  have hG1 : g 1=0 := by norm_num [g]
  have hLimit := hD.tendsto_slope.neg
  have hFn : (fun α : ℝ => -slope g 1 α)=
      (fun α : ℝ => (Real.log ((2:ℝ)^α+10)-α*Real.log 12)/(1-α)) := by
    funext α
    rw [slope_def_field,hG1,sub_zero]
    dsimp [g]
    have hDen : 1-α= -(α-1) := by ring
    rw [hDen,div_neg]
  rw [hFn] at hLimit
  convert hLimit using 1 <;> congr 1 <;> ring

theorem four_bit_complete_entropy_diagram :
    ∃ τ : ℝ, 6<τ ∧ τ<7 ∧ entropyTransitionPhi τ=0 ∧
      (∀ β : ℝ, 1<β → entropyTransitionPhi β=0 → β=τ) ∧
      (∀ α : ℝ, 0<α → ∀ q : (Fin 4 → Bool) → ℝ, cubeProbabilityFeasible q →
        (IsCubeRenyiGlobalMin α q ↔
